package.name: cavex_tracked_vehicle_gui
package.description: gz-gui plugins for the tracked BlueBoat's on-screen controls: ActionButtons (a small corner rectangle with two command buttons, used for Track deploy/retract and Rover lock/unlock) and ManualControl (a D-pad for driving + a turn-left/turn-right pair with a Manual toggle), ported and adapted from perception branch's sic_slam_gui for the tracked ground vehicle (no depth axis, no strafe -- turning instead).
